abstract: Performs gas and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry, assessing organic contaminant resolution ratings
system_message:
You are the Laboratory mass spectrometry lead (MSL), responsible for performing gas and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry and assessing organic contaminant resolution ratings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Performs gas and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry, assessing organic contaminant resolution ratings（SPEC）
information_points.content:
MSL-SPEC-OA7：For Rapid isotope tracer hydrology, the chromatographic resolution rating calculated over the trailing 60-day average is 80 points in peak separation assays.
MSL-SPEC-VLX：For Rapid isotope tracer hydrology, the chromatographic resolution rating evaluated across the trailing 14-day average is 70 points based on trace organic volatile compound peak separation assays.
MSL-SPEC-E5G：For Molecular bioassay and mass fingerprinting, the chromatographic resolution rating assessed over the trailing 14-day average is 70 points under standard volatile compound separation protocols.
MSL-SPEC-CEI：For Spectral fluorometry sensor grid, the chromatographic resolution rating measured over the trailing 14-day average stands at 80 points in trace organic volatile compound peak separation testing.

information_points.title: Carrier gas purge efficiency（FLUX）
information_points.content:
MSL-FLUX-K4G：Under high-purity helium elution columns during inlet bake-out, the Rapid isotope tracer hydrology plan demonstrated a carrier gas purge flow rate of 450 mL/min.
MSL-FLUX-IWS：During diagnostic runs on high-purity helium elution columns during inlet bake-out, the Spectral fluorometry sensor grid plan showed a carrier gas purge flow rate of 350 mL/min.
MSL-FLUX-ZW7：For the Molecular bioassay and mass fingerprinting plan, volumetric purge velocity measurements during instrument inlet bake-out recorded a carrier gas purge flow rate of 250 mL/min.
